title: No TTL/expiration for received routes and peers
description: Lines 270, 536: Entries persist indefinitely. Add pruning mechanism or document caller responsibility.
close_reason: Added TTL expiration for seen and pinned_keys entries. New fields: created_ms timestamps. New methods: expire_seen(), expire_pinned(), expire_all(). Constants: SEEN_TTL_MS (600s), PINNED_KEY_TTL_MS (24h). Callers should invoke expire methods periodically for cleanup.
